servinfo.title: Precautions for Handling of Rear Vehicle Height Sensor (Headlight Auto Leveling Model)

attention4.ptxt: Failure to take the following precautions may cause faulty operation or damage to the rear vehicle height sensor.

item.ptxt: Do not drop or expose the sensor to large shock. Any rear vehicle height sensor that has received large shock should be replaced.

servinfo.ptxt: Initialize headlight auto leveling system whenever rear vehicle height sensor is replaced or reinstalled.
